fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM89,950. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0053640/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: i. Pass STPM or equivalent with at least: Grade C in 3 subjects including General Studies/General Papers; OR Grade C in 2 subjects including General Studies/General Papers and Grade D in 2 other subjects ii. Pass A-Level with at least Grade C (CGPA 2.00) in 2 subjects and credits in Mathematics and Science and pass in English at SPM level; OR iii. Pass South Australian Matriculation (SAM) with minimum 65–75%; OR iv. Pass Canadian Pre-University (CPU) with minimum 80%; OR v. Pass STAM (Jayyid level); OR vi. Pass UEC with Grade B in 5 subjects; OR vii. Pass Matriculation/Foundation with minimum CGPA of 2.00; OR viii. Diploma in a related field with minimum CGPA of 2.00; OR ix. Any other equivalent qualification recognised by MSU Senate
